description: This PHP source file defines the BuzzDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides data access methods for managing Buzz-related entities such as posts, comments, shares, media, and likes in a social feed context. The class includes methods for CRUD operations, querying, and updating metrics related to Buzz posts and interactions.

classes.name: BuzzDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for Buzz-related entities, providing methods for CRUD operations, complex queries, and metrics adjustments concerning posts, comments, shares, likes, and media in the social feed module.

methods.name: getBuzzFeedPosts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of BuzzFeedPost objects based on provided filter parameters, including post details, likes, comments, and related media.

methods.name: getBuzzFeedPostsCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of Buzz feed posts matching the specified filter criteria.

methods.name: getBuzzFeedPostsQueryBuilder
methods.description: Constructs a query builder for fetching Buzz share posts with optional filters and sorting.

methods.name: getBuzzPhotoIdsByPostId
methods.description: Returns an array of photo IDs associated with a specific post ID.

methods.name: saveBuzzPost
methods.description: Persists a BuzzPost entity to the database.

methods.name: saveBuzzShare
methods.description: Persists a BuzzShare entity to the database.

methods.name: saveBuzzVideo
methods.description: Persists a BuzzLink (video link) entity to the database.

methods.name: saveBuzzPhoto
methods.description: Persists a BuzzPhoto entity to the database.

methods.name: saveBuzzComment
methods.description: Persists a BuzzComment entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteBuzzComment
methods.description: Removes a BuzzComment entity from the database.

methods.name: getBuzzPhotoById
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzPhoto entity by its ID.

methods.name: getBuzzShareById
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzShare entity by its ID.

methods.name: getBuzzCommentById
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzComment entity by its ID, with optional share filtering.

methods.name: getBuzzComments
methods.description: Fetches a list of BuzzComment entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzCommentsCount
methods.description: Counts the number of BuzzComments matching given filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzCommentsPaginator
methods.description: Builds a paginated query for fetching comments with filters and sorting.

methods.name: isEmployeeLikedOnComment
methods.description: Checks if a specific employee has liked a particular comment.

methods.name: getBuzzPostById
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzPost by its ID, including related employee and media info.

methods.name: getBuzzPostTypeByPostId
methods.description: Determines if a post is a photo, video, or text based on associated media and links.

methods.name: deleteBuzzPostPhotos
methods.description: Deletes specified photos associated with a post.

methods.name: getBuzzLinkByPostId
methods.description: Fetches the link entity associated with a post, if any.

methods.name: deleteBuzzPost
methods.description: Deletes a BuzzPost by its ID.

methods.name: deleteBuzzShare
methods.description: Deletes a BuzzShare by its ID.

methods.name: adjustLikeAndCommentCountsOnShares
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the total likes and comments counts for each share.

methods.name: adjustLikeCountOnComments
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the total likes count for comments.

methods.name: getBuzzShareByPostId
methods.description: Fetches the share entity corresponding to a specific post.

methods.name: getBuzzPostSharesList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of shares associated with a specific post based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzPostSharesCount
methods.description: Counts shares associated with a specific post based on filter parameters.
